svg.title: MetalClaw Pico RP2 pinout
svg.desc: Top view, USB at the top. Physical Pico-facing pins, connected RP2354B GPIO branches, selected carrier peripheral functions, target SWD and carrier J2 SWD.
svg.text: Top view · pin 1 at upper right
Pin numbers and Pico labels refer to the target interface. GP numbers in the RP2354B columns belong to the carrier.
Selected carrier functions shown. Unused branches: inputs, pulls off. Only one push-pull driver per target net.
